schedule.title: Scheduled tasks

tip.tasks: Sessions are triggered by schedule rules. Use "Run log" in a row to view its trigger history.
tip.logs: Review every trigger (including failed skips); open a session for details.
tip.dispatch: Configure the dispatch policy: sleep behavior, maximum concurrent tasks and the task watchdog interval.

schedule.emptyTip: Once created, sessions are triggered by the schedule rule; results are available in the session and run log.

sessionMode.label: Session mode
sessionMode.reuseTip: If the reused session was deleted or no longer exists, a new one is created.

sessionBlockPolicy.label: Session blocking policy
sessionBlockPolicy.skipTip: Reused session running: skip this run.
sessionBlockPolicy.forceTip: Reused session running: stop it and rerun.

fields.name: Task name
fields.promptPlaceholder: Content sent to the Agent on each run
fields.permissionTip: Scheduled runs are unattended: out-of-workspace writes and commands are denied automatically. Select "Full access" if the task needs a wider scope.
fields.humanModeFixedOff: Scheduled runs never pause for human confirmation: out-of-scope operations are denied automatically, and questions are handled by the model.
fields.timeoutTip: The watchdog stops this run once it exceeds the limit. With no limit, runs are never stopped automatically.

rule.triggerTip: Click to configure the schedule rule
rule.previewEmpty: This rule has no future run

desc.monthlyAndWeekly: Monthly on day {0} and weekly on {1} at {2}

schedule.deleteConfirm: Delete scheduled task "{0}"? Session history will be kept and its run log will be deleted.

logs.clearTip: Delete run logs by task and trigger time range. Deletion cannot be undone; session history is not affected. Select at least a task or a time range.
logs.clearRequired: Select at least a task or a time range

dispatch.keepAwakeDesc: Prevent the computer from sleeping (the display may still turn off) so scheduled tasks are not suspended. Closing the lid or sleeping manually still pauses them.
dispatch.maxConcurrencyDesc: Upper limit of simultaneously running tasks ({0} ~ {1}). Triggers beyond the limit are recorded as skipped.
dispatch.watchdogIntervalDesc: How often (in seconds) to check tasks: correct timers and stop runs that exceed their timeout ({0} ~ {1} seconds).

dailyNews.name: Daily briefing
dailyNews.prompt: Every morning, gather today's hot topics from 2-3 authoritative tech news sites and pick 5 noteworthy items, each with a one-sentence takeaway and source link. Choose the sources yourself, preferring official blogs and mainstream tech media. Write the result to briefing/YYYY-MM-DD.md, creating the folder if missing; list unreachable sites at the end. Read and write only inside the working directory, and skip any action that needs permission approval.

weeklyIndustry.name: Weekly industry watch
weeklyIndustry.prompt: Research last week's AI industry news, focusing on open-source models, AI products and applications, industry policy and moves of major players. Public sites are fine; choose the sources yourself, preferring official and authoritative media. Write a one-page watch: 3 trend judgments, 3 items worth following (with links) and 1 takeaway for us. Write the result to industry-watch/YYYY-Www.md, creating the folder if missing. Read and write only inside the working directory, and skip any action that needs permission approval.
